## Purpose and Entry Points
`agent-device` is a Node.js CLI, SDK, and MCP server for agent-driven inspection, interaction, verification, recording, and replay across mobile, TV, desktop, and web targets. Primary executable wiring begins at `bin/agent-device.mjs`, `src/bin.ts`, and `src/cli.ts`. Public programmatic APIs are exposed through `src/sdk/index.ts`; MCP transport/server entry is `src/mcp/server.ts`.

## CLI-to-Daemon Control Plane
The CLI parses command grammar, resolves local/remote connection profiles, and dispatches commands to a persistent local daemon rather than directly owning device state. Command definitions/projections live in `src/commands/index.ts`, `src/commands/command-surface.ts`, and `src/cli/commands/router.ts`. The daemon client/RPC boundary is `src/daemon/client/daemon-client.ts` and `src/daemon/client/daemon-client-rpc.ts`; daemon process startup is `src/daemon/daemon-process.ts`.

## Daemon: Session-Oriented Orchestrator
The daemon owns HTTP/RPC handling, device claims/leases, request serialization, session state, artifacts, and cleanup. Its key boundary is request routing through `src/daemon/request-router.ts`, scoped execution in `src/daemon/request-execution-scope.ts`, and runtime session lifecycle in `src/daemon/runtime-session.ts`. Session handlers translate command intents into platform/runtime operations; examples include `src/daemon/handlers/session-open.ts`, `src/daemon/handlers/interaction.ts`, and `src/daemon/handlers/snapshot.ts`. Durable recording/capture resources survive request boundaries via `src/daemon/durable-capture-resource-store.ts` and related recovery flows.

## Contracts, Core Dispatch, and Selector/Snapshot Model
Platform-neutral types and capability contracts isolate command orchestration from implementations: `packages/contracts/src/platform-runtime.ts`, `packages/contracts/src/snapshot-types.ts`, and `packages/contracts/src/interaction.ts`. Core dispatch selects plugins/interactors and normalizes backend results in `src/core/dispatch.ts`, `src/core/platform-plugin-registry.ts`, and `src/core/snapshot-tree-ingestion.ts`. Accessibility snapshots produce session-scoped refs; selectors resolve against normalized trees through `packages/selectors/src/index.ts` and `src/core/selector-pipeline.ts`. This is the principal correctness boundary for inspect → act → settle/verify behavior.

## Platform and Provider Runtime Layer
Local platform packages implement inventory, lifecycle, deployment, logging, networking, and recording behind contracts: `packages/platform-android/src/runtime.ts`, `packages/platform-apple/src/runtime.ts`, and `packages/platform-harmonyos/src/runtime.ts`. Host-specific execution is composed in `src/platform-runtime.ts` and `src/platform-runtime-host.ts`. Supported local backends use ADB/Android helpers (`src/platforms/android/adb.ts`, `src/platforms/android/snapshot-helper-session.ts`), Apple tooling plus XCTest runner (`src/platforms/apple/core/runner/runner-client.ts`), HDC/ArkUI, AT-SPI, Vega tooling, and agent-browser web support. Cloud/provider boundaries are implemented by `packages/provider-limrun/src/runtime.ts` and `packages/provider-webdriver/src/runtime.ts`, including BrowserStack and AWS Device Farm adapters.

## Native Automation Sidecars
Android’s instrumented snapshot helper captures accessibility trees and injects touch plans; its protocol and instrumentation are in `android/snapshot-helper/src/main/java/com/callstack/agentdevice/snapshothelper/HelperProtocol.java` and `android/snapshot-helper/src/main/java/com/callstack/agentdevice/snapshothelper/SnapshotInstrumentation.java`. Apple automation runs through an Xcode XCTest UI-test target, centered on `apple/runner/AgentDeviceRunner/AgentDeviceRunnerUITests/RunnerTests.swift` and command transport in `RunnerTests+Transport.swift`. macOS has a Swift accessibility/audio helper at `apple/macos-helper/Sources/AgentDeviceMacOSHelper/main.swift`.

## Recording, Replay, and Evidence
Session actions can be written as `.ad` scripts, replayed with target verification/resume semantics, or exported to Maestro-compatible YAML. Script format and annotations are in `packages/ad-script/src/index.ts`; replay step execution is in `packages/ad-replay/src/internal/step-loop.ts`; daemon replay coordination is `src/daemon/handlers/session-replay-runtime.ts`. The direct Maestro engine parses YAML, compiles plans, and executes through a runtime port in `packages/maestro/src/internal/engine.ts` and `packages/maestro/src/internal/replay-plan-compilation.ts`. Screenshots, video, logs, network data, and other evidence pass through capture/runtime artifacts managed by `packages/capture-kit/src/index.ts` and `src/daemon/runtime-artifacts.ts`.
